The second call, after the owner confirmed the words (product_image is the stored key the first answer gave).

slots.script: Fresh kaya toast every morning from 7am. Order ahead at 6123 4567.

description: [paid: up to $0.66 a run; template.list gives each template's price] Run one media template for this workspace. The product templates (product-shot, product-lifestyle, showcase-video) first read the words printed on the product and answer status needs_label with label_words and nothing charged: show the words to the owner, then call again with the same slots plus label_words set to the confirmed list (the answer's next says exactly how). Images land in the image library (asset_key and url; a download_url when signed links are on). showcase-video makes its still in the call and answers status rendering: the video takes 1 to 2 minutes, so call template.status with the run_id. explainer-voice answers with an MP3 and a WebVTT caption file. price.quoted_micro_usd is the most the run can cost; price.charged_micro_usd is what it did. Refuses: VALIDATION_ERROR (each slot issue named), SIMPLER_MEDIA_INPUT_MISSING / SIMPLER_MEDIA_URL_REFUSED (pass an asset_key, https or data:image), INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS (add credits), the prompt guard's refusals (slot words that name a real person, or sexual or other harmful content), SIMPLER_MEDIA_TEMPLATE_RUNS_UNMIGRATED (templates not switched on yet; nothing charged).

slots.description: The template's slot values by name; template.list names each template's slots (the templates that take a slot are in brackets). Image slots are an asset_key, https URL or data:image URL.

background.description: The studio sweep behind the product. (product-shot)

brand_text.description: The words in the logo, spelled exactly. (brand-mockup)

card_line.description: For the card: the line under the logo, e.g. 'Tan Wei Ming · Director · 6123 4567'. Left out, the card shows the logo only. (brand-mockup)

fixed_parts.description: What must stay exactly as photographed, e.g. 'cap, label layout' or 'glossy black panels, status lights and buttons'. (product-shot, product-lifestyle, showcase-video)

headline.description: The big line, spelled exactly as it should print. (poster)

label_words.description: Every word printed on the product, as the owner confirmed it. Leave it out on the first call: the template reads the label (free) and answers the words for the owner to confirm or correct; then call again with the confirmed list ([] when the product has no printed words). (product-shot, product-lifestyle, showcase-video)

language.description: en prints English type, zh Simplified Chinese (write the headline and subline in that language). (poster, explainer-voice)

logo_image.description: Your logo as a PNG or JPG, about 1200 px wide. (brand-mockup)

logo_look.description: In words, e.g. 'heavy bold black letterforms with a small purple dot'. (brand-mockup)

objects.description: Any of sign, tee, mug, card (one image each). (brand-mockup)

palette.description: The poster's colours, e.g. your brand colours. (poster)

phone.description: For the footer, as it should print. (poster)

port_note.description: For a device on the office desk, where its cables go, e.g. 'two blue ethernet cables plugged into the ports on the BACK of the router (the front panel has no ports),'. (product-lifestyle)

product_image.description: A phone photo of the product at full resolution (small print is lost below about 1500 px). (product-shot, product-lifestyle, poster, showcase-video)

product_noun.description: One or two words, e.g. 'bottle', 'router', 'tin of biscuits'. (product-lifestyle, showcase-video)

script.description: What the voice says, as the captions should show it (prices, phone numbers and web addresses are spoken the way people say them). Up to 1500 characters; about 450 make 30 seconds. (explainer-voice)

setting.description: hdb-kitchen (an HDB flat's kitchen counter), sg-office (a small office desk) or shop-counter (a provision shop's glass counter). (product-lifestyle)

website.description: For the footer, as it should print. (poster)

name: template.run
